_about: Register entries for .github/scripts/check-x-not-y.py, for pages that carry no `<!-- audience: ... -->` marker and sit outside the trees the script already knows. The trip starter kit's pages are copies of child-facing templates (tests/test_trip_starter_kit_copies.py keeps them in step), so they take no marker of their own. An audience marker on a page overrides its entry here.

framework/trip_starter/README.md.basis: inferred: no audience statement; addresses the child ("ask an adult"), and the kit's pages are copies of child-facing templates

framework/trip_starter/family/current_fa.basis: copy of a child-facing template (names its blank in framework/templates/); no audience marker

framework/trip_starter/family/family_tri.basis: copy of a child-facing template (names its blank in framework/templates/); no audience marker

framework/trip_starter/family/traveler_p.basis: inferred: no audience statement; addresses the child ("if you did Session 02"), and names its blank in framework/templates/

framework/trip_starter/family/trip_basic.basis: copy of a child-facing template (names its blank in framework/templates/); no audience marker
